summary: Feed c032_broker_nic is degraded: NPB-01 port 12 to IDS is saturated at 100% of 1 Gbps (bursts higher) causing 47.86% loss (9,835,680 discards) at broker plus 0.75% loss (80,280 discards) at IDS eth1. IDS is missing nearly half of traffic.

findings.root_cause: NPB-01 port 12 (to IDS) is persistently oversubscribed - average load at 100% of 1 Gbps with bursts exceeding line rate. Egress queue tail-drops 9,835,680 packets (47.86% lost). Downstream IDS eth1 capture interface also overrun, dropping an additional 80,280 packets (0.75% lost) because 1G tool port cannot keep up.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS misses ~48% of packets. With needs_both_directions=true and needs_full_payload=true, TCP reassembly, flow state and signature matching break, causing high false-negative rate and blind spots for intrusion detection. Bursty attacks are most likely to be lost.

params.alternative: upgrade NPB-01:12 and IDS eth1 to 10G and/or filter to <70% utilization

recommended_fix.why: Spreading traffic with flow-aware load balancing (or upgrading link/tool to 10G) removes egress congestion and tool overrun while preserving bidirectional flow affinity required by IDS for stateful detection. Filtering non-essential traffic can also reduce load below 1G if cluster upgrade not possible.
